meta.title: Contractor hourly rate cards by region, role and grade, 2025-2026
meta.purpose: Machine-usable external cost base for the should-cost cockpit: RU onshore, KZ/nearshore, India offshore, Poland/EU nearshore.
meta.currency_policy: No FX conversion is applied. RU is RUB/hour as quoted. KZ, India and Poland are USD/hour as quoted by the sources; KZ local payroll is KZT and is not converted here. If a single-currency view is required, apply a sourced central-bank rate on the estimate date and record rate and date.
meta.basis: Hourly billing rate, exclusive of VAT unless the row says otherwise. T&M is the default; fixed price and dedicated team are separate bases.

provenance.licence_note: Market rate surveys are cited, not redistributed. No ISBSG rows are shipped.

confidence_legend.High: A named survey or vendor price list states the band directly for that region and grade.
confidence_legend.Medium: A reputable secondary compilation, or a grade/role band that is broadly consistent with a second ledger.
confidence_legend.Low: Blog compilation, small sample, or ambiguous basis.
confidence_legend.Proxy: No published band for that region/role/grade; the value is interpolated, bounded by a sourced band, or a documented planning assumption. Request a quote before pricing.

role_adjustment_policy.method: No role index is applied. Public rate cards are published by grade, not by role. Every role therefore inherits the same sourced grade band, except 1C (sourced role band) and cross-checks. Role differentiation in the product comes from assigning a role to a grade (e.g. architect=senior/lead, QA manual=junior/middle), not from a fabricated role multiplier.
role_adjustment_policy.rationale: A role salary ratio is a payroll fact, not a billing-rate fact. Applying it to a rate card would silently invent a rate. Documented explicitly so the model does not over-claim precision.

meta.vat_policy: Every row carries vat_included, vat_rate_pct and vat_flag. RU VAT is 20% (research/10). KZ/India/Poland VAT/GST is not in the research pack, so vat_rate_pct is null and must be filled from a sourced local rate. Never silently add VAT.

recalibration.procedure: Replace the market_grade_band with the vendor's quoted band; keep the role and grade labels; rerun. If the quote is in a local currency, record the FX rate and date; do not convert without a sourced rate.
recalibration.minimum_sample: At least 3 vendor quotes per region/grade (research/14: NMCK rule of >=3 prices and CV <=33%).

basis_definitions.T&M: Time and materials: hourly rate x actual hours. Customer carries scope risk; change orders are priced at the same or a pre-agreed rate.
basis_definitions.fixed_price: Vendor carries scope risk. Add the sourced 15-30% fixed-price risk load to the T&M rate only when scope and acceptance criteria are fixed; do not use the T&M rate as a fixed price without a risk load.
basis_definitions.dedicated_team: Monthly all-in team price, customer directs the team. Use the dedicated_team_monthly table; do not multiply an hourly rate by 160 h without checking the all-in scope.

meta.dedicated_team_policy: Dedicated-team prices are monthly all-in and are a different unit from hourly rates. They are listed separately and must not be summed with hourly rows.

confidence.Low: Blog compilation, small sample, or ambiguous basis.
